purpose: Pre-T specification of the external at-most-once canary and restore-generation fence.

store.consistency: single-primary synchronous commit; reads for authorization use the primary

canary_authorizations.terminal_state_constraint: state <> 'UNUSED' OR (intent_uuid IS NULL AND payload_hash IS NULL)
canary_authorizations.consumed_tuple_constraint: state <> 'CONSUMED_BY' OR (intent_uuid IS NOT NULL AND payload_hash IS NOT NULL)
canary_authorizations.revoked_tuple_constraint: state <> 'REVOKED_BY' OR (intent_uuid IS NOT NULL AND payload_hash IS NOT NULL)

restore_fence.generation_rule: generation may increase only; an UPDATE with generation <= current generation is rejected

consume.idempotency: a second consume returns terminal conflict and never mutates the row
consume.commit: single transaction; COMMIT waits for WAL flush before success is returned

revoke.race_rule: consume and revoke serialize; exactly one terminal transition wins; loser observes terminal state

read.authorization_rule: external tuple must exactly match intent_uuid, payload_hash, and restore_generation

bump_restore_generation.lock: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on restore_fence singleton
bump_restore_generation.ordering: must commit before any trading-DB replacement/open
bump_restore_generation.result: returns the new generation and immutable snapshot identity binding

restore_protocol.generation_mismatch: RECOVERY_ONLY; invalidate old authorizations; require a newly signed authorization
restore_protocol.fence_unreachable: RECOVERY_ONLY; no ARM, RESERVE, SUBMIT, consume, or revoke
restore_protocol.snapshot_identity: immutable manifest digest bound to the bumped generation

failure_rules.unknown_commit_outcome: re-read the primary by key; never retry with a new intent
